title: Stream.toList() returns an UNMODIFIABLE list — a later .add() throws where collect(toList()) did not
notes: A naive modernization of collect(Collectors.toList()) to Stream.toList() would BREAK this code: Stream.toList() returns an unmodifiable list, so the subsequent result.add("EXPEDITE") throws UnsupportedOperationException. Because the list is mutated here, the collect(toList()) must stay (or become a mutable copy). This is exactly the behavioural edge case a mechanical upgrade misses; the invariant is the filtered SKUs plus EXPEDITE.
